rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the stronger no-invented-denial prompt rule that followed the holdout9 gate failure (one fabricated denial); never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout10.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout9 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout9 (consumed 2026-11-03: gate failed 7/8, one invented denial on a medical-sounding request).
